6505.title: Automation process-group cleanup skips ordinary completion
6505.rootCauseOneLine: The close handler cancels its timers but kills remaining group members only after timeout or output overflow, leaving unreferenced workers alive on ordinary completion.
6505.proposedFix: Unconditionally clean up remaining process-group members at close, preserving exit results and platform fallback; add the authored exit-0/exit-7 regression and clarify runtime documentation.
6505.caveats: Reproduced twice on Linux with Node 22; macOS desktop shutdown and memory exhaustion were not exercised. Regression patch and sanitized logs are inline under the report repository's publication policy.
